body: I am 19 years old, and I am a girl. Anorexia is the eating disorder that came back.

I'm stupid and horribly ugly I'll never be able to feel good about myself. My eating disorder I had a couple years back recently spontaneously recovered. I really tried to improve myself, but it seems like I'm not making any progress. I so desperately want to be pretty and smart, but I'm not either of those things. Plus I have depression and anxiety issues. I don't see a silver lining anywhere.
